definition.title: Shared payer admission and replacement obligations
definition.expectedInvariant: Pending payer obligations fit its balance; a replacement excludes the displaced obligation.
preconditions: One transaction fits the fresh payer balance but two do not
Manual bundling preserves pending entries during accounting observations

limitations: Fresh staged-fork mining fixture; manual sidecar bundling and ordinary canonical transfers.
Seed identifies action order, not private signing keys; fresh accounts are random.
Only the explicitly defined actions are checked; terminal/TTL and submitted-entry exceptions are outside this run.
